title: Tenant leak / restricted disclosure
action: Hold affected operations; preserve safe evidence; incident escalation.

title: Unauthorized official or financial write
action: Hold fresh writes; checkpoint queues; reconcile committed outcomes.

title: Data corruption / failed reconciliation
action: Hold writes; isolate repair/restore; reconcile object bytes and external records.

title: Withdrawn / expired authority
action: Hold affected scope; fresh authority required before resume.

title: AI gateway/policy bypass
action: Hold AI dispatch across entry points; settle budgets and investigate.

title: Pseudonymous identity disclosure
action: Hold affected surface; privacy-safe review, never reveal names as fallback.

title: Missing support / alerts / backup
action: Hold activation or expansion; restore operated coverage.

title: Accepted service threshold breached
action: Hold affected feature; diagnose against populated accepted threshold.
